task: Multi-object tracking on a simulated dense-occlusion sequence
named_methods: ByteTrack (cascade by detection score: high then low)
SparseTrack (Depth Cascade Matching via pseudo-depth = bbox bottom y; hierarchical/sparse subset association on top of ByteTrack-style score cascade)
input: Per-frame detections with bbox + score + gt_id and per-frame gt_bboxes/gt_ids
output_per_method: Trajectories: list of (frame, track_id, bbox) ; evaluation against ground-truth IDs
comparison_axis: ByteTrack vs SparseTrack on the same simulated_sequence.json
constraints: Pure-numpy/scipy implementation; reproducible; no extra detector training; deterministic association
